caption: “Fruit Shape of Each of the Eight Cultivar Groups of Cucurbita Pepo. Proximal (stem) end is at top, distal (blossom end at bottom.” Harry S. Paris. “A Proposed Subspecific Classification for Cucurbita-Pepo.” Phytologia 61.3 (November 1986: 133-138), 136.
alt: Outline drawings of the fruit shapes of eight kinds of summer and winter squash, each labelled: round pumpkin, flat scallop, ribbed acorn, curved crookneck, straightneck, vegetable marrow, long cocozelle and zucchini.
bibliography: Paris, Harry S. "Fruit Shape of Each of the Eight Cultivar Groups of Cucurbita pepo." "A Proposed Subspecific Classification for Cucurbita pepo," Phytologia, vol. 61, no. 3, Nov. 1986, pp. 133–138.
